title: MIND OVER MATTER - Toronto's most popular illusion show
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: All sales are final. No refund is available for cancellations.
blurb:
The only Las Vegas style magic show in Toronto! Join us for jaw dropping moments with "Toronto's most popular mind-reading duo" (BlogTO).

Beyond Mental Borders, the highly praised mentalism team, take you through “an unforgettable night of mental magic with a blend of humour, charm, assertiveness, and a series of tests that challenge the strongest of skeptics.” (Broadway World)

Doors open 30 minutes prior to showtime!
